name: Clown OG 1g Pre-Roll
description:
Lineage: SFV OG x Wedding Cake

Breeder: Beanfiendz

Terpenes: Linalool, Limonene, Myrcene

Aroma: Sweet, Floral, Citrus

Effects: Sleepy, Hungry, Relaxed

Welcome to the carnival of relaxation with Clown OG, where every puff is a ticket to tranquility. A dazzling hybrid of SFV OG and Wedding Cake, this strain is like a carnival ride for your senses. Its frosty, colorful buds shimmer with trichomes, releasing a sweet, earthy aroma laced with floral lavender and a hint of zesty citrus. As the effects roll in, you’ll feel a wave of calm sweep over you, leaving you blissfully relaxed, slightly hungry, and ready to enjoy a cozy night. Perfect for those looking to unwind after the day’s excitement, Clown OG delivers a sweet, restful escape straight from the big top.
